theorem ack_add_one_sq_lt_ack_add_four (m n : ℕ) : ack m ((n + 1) ^ 2) < ack (m + 4) n :=
  calc
    ack m ((n + 1) ^ 2) < ack m ((ack m n + 1) ^ 2) :=
      ack_strictMono_right m <| Nat.pow_lt_pow_left (succ_lt_succ <| lt_ack_right m n) two_ne_zero
    _ ≤ ack m (ack (m + 3) n) := ack_mono_right m <| ack_add_one_sq_lt_ack_add_three m n

    _ = ack (m + 3) (n + 1) := (ack_succ_succ _ n).symm
    _ ≤ ack (m + 4) n := ack_succ_right_le_ack_succ_left _ n

--src: Mathlib.NumberTheory.LucasLehmer
theorem sModNat_eq_sMod (p k : ℕ) (hp : 2 ≤ p) : (sModNat (2 ^ p - 1) k : ℤ) = sMod p k := by
  have h1 := calc
    4 = 2 ^ 2 := by norm_num
    _ ≤ 2 ^ p := Nat.pow_le_pow_of_le_right (by norm_num) hp
  have h2 : 1 ≤ 2 ^ p := by omega
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    rw [sModNat, sMod, Int.ofNat_emod]
    simp [h2]
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [sModNat, sMod, ← ih]
    have h3 : 2 ≤ 2 ^ p - 1 := by
      zify [h2]
      calc
        (2 : Int) ≤ 4 - 1 := by norm_num
        _         ≤ 2 ^ p - 1 := by zify at h1; exact Int.sub_le_sub_right h1 _
    zify [h2, h3]
    rw [← add_sub_assoc, sub_eq_add_neg, add_assoc, add_comm _ (-2), ← add_assoc,
      Int.add_emod_self, ← sub_eq_add_neg]
